Verkada is hiring a Full Stack Engineer for its Business Systems Engineering team. The role builds and improves tools, services, integrations, and data pipelines used by Go-to-Market teams, while identifying operational bottlenecks and developing technical solutions with business stakeholders.

Responsibilities
Collaborate with a team of engineers to implement new features, optimize existing systems for usability, and scale data pipelines for growth
Work with business stakeholders to understand their needs and design technical solutions based on high level requirements
Write software in a variety of languages including Apex, JavaScript, and Golang
Build cloud based services in the AWS platform that addresses reliability and scale
Decide when to build from scratch versus leveraging existing tools or external solutions
Implement integrations with third-party software
You should be comfortable learning new systems and APIs quickly to make informed decisions about whether to adopt and implement new technologies
Develop customer empathy to propose improvements to systems
